packages.name: hyperref
packages.silent_options: colorlinks, hidelinks, bookmarks, bookmarksopen, bookmarksnumbered, linktoc, breaklinks, unicode, pageanchor, hyperfootnotes, pdfstartview, pdfpagemode
packages.description: loading hyperref moves no glyph (measured against pdflatex, TeX Live 2025: the same document with and without it is 1062 words on 4 pages, 0 moved), and the link-colour, border, outline, viewer and pdf* metadata keys are accepted with it; \url, \href and \nolinkurl are typeset, while the PDF links, bookmarks and link colours still missing are reported once by their own diagnostic; backref and pagebackref add bibliography text and keep warning

packages.name: cleveref
packages.description: named cross-references with compressed ranges; unknown package options are silently ignored

packages.name: color
packages.description: color.sty colours with pdfTeX's exact operator values

packages.name: xcolor
packages.silent_options: natural, rgb, cmy, cmyk, gray, dvipsnames, svgnames, x11names, table
packages.description: xcolor 3.02 definitions, expressions and target models with pdfTeX's exact operator values; hsb models, colour series and table colours are diagnosed

packages.name: amsmath
packages.description: the align, gather, multline, split, aligned, gathered, cases and matrix families; \dfrac, \tfrac, \binom, \genfrac, \cfrac, \substack, \operatorname, \DeclareMathOperator, \boxed, \phantom, \overset/\underset, the extensible arrows, \text in math, \tag/\notag and \eqref, with \lim-family, \sum and \prod display limits and amsmath's wider \colon. Its defaults are the accepted options; leqno, fleqn, tbtags, nosumlimits, intlimits and nonamelimits move real output and keep warning. \sideset, \shoveleft, \smash, \mspace, \hdotsfor and \varinjlim are each diagnosed where they are used

packages.name: amssymb
packages.description: the full AMSa/AMSb (msam/msbm) inventory of amssymb.sty -- 203 names base LaTeX2e leaves undefined (\square, \nleq, ...) -- plus everything amsfonts declares; loading the package is what makes the names exist, and a name whose file was not loaded is diagnosed

packages.name: amsfonts
packages.description: amsfonts.sty's 22-name symbol subset (\ulcorner, \square, \yen, the dashed arrows) and the \mathbb and \mathfrak alphabets; the rest of amssymb stays undefined without \usepackage{amssymb}

packages.name: amsthm
packages.description: \newtheorem, \theoremstyle and the proof environment

packages.name: array
packages.description: tabular >{} <{} !{} m b w columns, \newcolumntype and \extrarowheight

packages.name: booktabs
packages.description: \toprule, \midrule, \bottomrule, \cmidrule(trim), \addlinespace, \specialrule, \morecmidrules

packages.name: longtable
packages.description: the page-breaking longtable environment: \endfirsthead, \endhead, \endfoot, \endlastfoot, \caption, \kill, \\*

packages.name: multirow
packages.description: \multirow[vpos]{rows}[bigstruts]{width}[vmove]{text} in table entries

packages.name: colortbl
packages.description: \rowcolor, \cellcolor, >{\columncolor}, \arrayrulecolor, \doublerulesepcolor

packages.name: enumitem
packages.description: list keys (label, start, resume, seps, margins) parsed as options; \setlist

packages.name: geometry
packages.description: matches the fixed US Letter page with 1in margins

packages.name: siunitx
packages.description: v3 \num, \unit, \qty, lists, ranges, \ang, \sisetup and \DeclareSIUnit; unmodelled keys are diagnosed

packages.name: multicol
packages.description: multicols and multicols* with preface, \columnbreak, \raggedcolumns (columns set by the render pipeline)

packages.name: natbib
packages.silent_options: numbers, authoryear, round, square, angle, curly, comma, semicolon, colon, nobibstyle, bibstyle, sectionbib, longnamesfirst, nonamebreak
packages.description: \citet/\citep/\citealt/\citealp/\citeauthor/\citeyear/\citeyearpar/\citenum/\citetext and the \cite it redefines, with [Author(Year)] \bibitem labels; sort, compress, super and openbib are diagnosed

packages.name: ulem
packages.description: \uline: 0.4pt rule under the argument (single-line); \sout: 0.4pt strike at 0.55ex; \emph is not redefined

packages.name: xspace
packages.description: \xspace inserts a word space unless the next token is }, , . ' / ? ; : ! ~ - ), or a short suppressing-command list (\footnote, \footnotemark, \bgroup, \egroup, control space)

packages.name: ifthen
packages.description: \ifthenelse with \equal, \NOT, \AND, \OR, \isodd, \isundefined, \lengthtest and \boolean tests, and \newif conditionals with \newboolean/\setboolean; \whiledo loops are diagnosed where they are used
